correctness.rationale: For each fixed i the observed younger-parent forest fixes internal edges and the separate events P_r<=i for its component roots; remaining root-parent choices are independently uniform over i old labels. Thus the independent Bernoulli component law and conditional product are exact for every n and boundary. This implies conditional mean n/i for any younger-size statistic. Standard two-color Polya urn moments give each marginal variance, with vanishing off-diagonal covariance by tower property. Double counting ancestors proves weighted total path variance for every real deterministic weight vector. Exact replay of all 5913 trees for n=2..8 passed 9326 conditional coefficient/moment assertions; finitary checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full conditional probability-generating polynomial for a fixed birth-ranked subtree, conditional on all newer-to-newer parent edges, is an all-size structural law. It implies one-way conditional mean independence with respect to arbitrary later-subtree-size observables while disproving ordinary independence. Its exact diagonal covariance matrix yields variances for arbitrary birth-weighted ancestor path costs, a natural generalization of standard total path length, without computing any mixed correlations. This is stronger than a routine marginal moment identity and not a tiny parameter-specific gain.
